svg.title: PrimusScope system overview
svg.desc: Public BSC and Base observations are validated and served through Blob and Next.js. Neon history is read-only. SDK attestation input stays in the browser; only consented diagnostic metadata reaches a separate private Blob path.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Public chains
BSC 56: Finance + shared strategy
Base 8453: registered Network events

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Hourly bounded collector
Versioned ABIs, runtime / receipt checks
Transactional SQLite job state
